objects.name: Apple Patches Dozens of Vulnerabilities Across iOS, macOS, and Safari
objects.description: The updates fix vulnerabilities in WebKit, the kernel, WebRTC, Web Extensions, and other components affecting iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Safari users. The post Apple Patches Dozens of Vulnerabilities Across iOS, macOS, and Safari appeared first on SecurityWeek .
